evidence.title: Expandable Control · React motion component · beUI

name: Expandable Control
summary: Click-to-expand React button and chip controls that reveal a label or trailing action with spring layout continuity.
description: Two motion components for React and Next.js: ExpandableButton, an icon button that expands to reveal its label, and ExpandableChip, a chip that expands to reveal a trailing action. Both animate through spring layout continuity and support controlled or uncontrolled expanded state with onExpandedChange. Free and open source; install with the shadcn CLI (@beui/expandable-control) or copy the source; theme tokens are needed once.
contains: ExpandableButton: icon button that expands to reveal its label
ExpandableChip: chip that expands to reveal a trailing action
chip props: actionIcon, actionLabel, onAction, collapseOnAction, disabled, labelClassName, actionClassName
shared props: expanded, defaultExpanded, onExpandedChange, className
free, open-source React and Next.js component; updated Aug 22, 2026
